answer_1.quote: We apply DOCLENS to three medical generation tasks: clinical note generation, radiology report summarization, and patient question summarization.
answer_1.outputs: generated clinical notes, radiology impression summaries, patient question summaries

answer_2.quote: We also apply existing commonly‑used metrics. We list the metrics for each task in Table ...

answer_3.quote: We also apply instruction‑following models to compute the metrics, including proprietary and open‑source models. To compute claim recall and claim precision, we prompt the evaluator to generate "1" or "0" for each claim based on whether they can be supported.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to check the alignment of different evaluation methods with medical experts. Five medical experts annotated claim coverage and indicated which note was more complete.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked (1) whether each claim is fully supported by each generated note, and (2) which note they think is more complete.
